name: GlobeHops
description: Explore air journeys on an interactive globe; shared route estimates and local-time schedules for people and agents.

label.semantics: Trimmed journey/alternative A label; URL-encode Unicode and reserved characters.

b./c./d..format: prefix + route|depN|arrN|label or nested 2.–6. section groups
b./c./d..semantics: Journeys B–D in order; gaps compact. Each group requires route. Parameter keys are case-insensitive. Other view parameters remain unprefixed; leg refers to A, clock may name any airport across all alternatives and their sections.

2.–6..semantics: A trip's sections after the first (up to 6 in all), in order; the first uses the unprefixed parameters. Sections are sequential journeys separated by explicit stays; connections stay inside a section. stay (days d, hours h or minutes m) places a section without times after the previous one (default 7 days). Compose with b.–d. for compared trips (b.2.* through d.6.*); leg counts flights across A’s sections.

airspace.semantics: Restricted-airspace avoidance for this visit (app default on); overrides the saved preference.

diversion.semantics: Diversion-aware routing for this visit (app default on): keep flights within modelled reach of potential diversion airports. Not an ETOPS authorisation.

route.semantics: Up to ten stops; transfer suffix _minutes overrides the default layover. Explicit empty route clears the route.

depN/arrN.semantics: Airport-local wall time at 1-based stop N. Optional :00 seconds. Date-only links are accepted as incomplete; documents require a time. Arrival at origin and departure at destination are ignored.

t.format: ISO instant with Z or offset
t.semantics: Simulation clock instant, independent of airport-local input times.

play.semantics: Start playback on open; reduced motion prevents autoplay.

speed.semantics: Simulation seconds per real second; auto covers the journey in about 15 seconds.

clock.semantics: Timeline display zone; airport code must belong to any journey or section of any alternative.

follow.semantics: Follow the aircraft with the camera; off by default. User camera input exits follow.

lang.semantics: Language; generated URLs use locale paths /en/, /hu/, /sv/. Query lang is an alias on the unprefixed path. Explicit path takes precedence.

names.semantics: Place-name labels for this visit; overrides saved preference.

borders.semantics: Country borders for this visit; overrides saved preference.

leg.semantics: Frames the selected flight; must exist in the route (in a trip, flights count across sections, up to 54). Does not change the simulation instant.

itinerary.semantics: ItineraryDocument v1 overrides readable parameters; structural schema linked below.

comparison.document: Version 1; exactly one of stops, journeys or sections. Journeys: 1–4 labelled alternatives, each exactly one of stops or sections; every alternative uses the same form and section count (1–6).
comparison.alignment: Entered schedules remain absolute. Undated journeys align to the earliest dated departure, else assumeDeparture; without either they have no timeline.
comparison.metrics: Fastest is shortest total journey duration; arrives first is earliest final UTC arrival. Exact ties have no winner. Invalid or fewer-than-two-stop journeys are excluded; arrival comparison requires every valid journey to have an end.

trips.document: Version 1; sections: 1–6 sequential journeys, each with stops and an optional label; later sections may carry stayMinutes (0–525600).
trips.stays: A stay is the time between one section arriving and the next departing, at the same airport or an open jaw. It is never a layover and is never inferred from duration. Its length comes from both sections’ times, else from stayMinutes (default 7 days), with estimated/assumed provenance.
trips.playback: One traveller flies the sections in order on one UTC clock; automatic playback skips stays without changing any instant. Compared trips use one clock across alternatives, each with sequential sections; shared stays can be skipped without changing instants.
trips.outputs: calculate_route returns kind "trip" with sections (journey details), stays (minutes, calendar days, source, provenance) and trip totals; get_journey_timeline reports a "stay" phase between sections.

comparedTrips.links: A: unprefixed plus 2.*–6.*; B–D: b.* plus b.2.*–b.6.*, through d.6.*. Links tolerate unequal counts; documents pad empty sections then fail validation until filled.
comparedTrips.alignment: An untimed trip lines up journey by journey with the earliest timed counterpart unless the traveller chose the stay. Entered times remain absolute.
comparedTrips.metrics: Only complete valid trips are ranked by travelMinutes (flights plus connections across sections), excluding stays. Per-section winners/deltas compare section k with section k. Ties have no winner.
comparedTrips.input: compare_journeys: each alternative supplies route, stops or sections; sections supply route or stops, label?, stay? (integer minutes or 5d/36h/90m). route plus returnRoute and optional stay is a two-section shorthand. Equal section counts required.
comparedTrips.output: kind trip_comparison; journeys: id/label/color/anchor/sections/stays/totals (trip totals plus travelMinutes). comparison: fastest, ranking (id/travelMinutes/deltaMinutes), sections (name/fastest/per-ID deltaMinutes). Plain comparisons add kind comparison. get_journey_timeline remains single journey/trip only.

routing.default: Agent and MCP results follow great circles unless routing is requested; the app routes by default.
routing.airspace: Routes around EASA conflict-zone bulletins valid on the flight date, assuming an EU/EEA operator. See data/AIRSPACE.md.

diversion.semantics: ETOPS/EDTO-inspired: keeps flights within still-air reach of potential diversion airports (open large/medium airports with a paved runway of at least 2,000 m by 45 m, OurAirports) or their own endpoints. Covered keeps the route, adjusted re-routes within a modest allowance, gap keeps the unconstrained route and reports the longest modelled diversion time. Not an operator authorisation; winds, tracks, airways and ATC are not modelled. See data/DIVERSION.md.

routing.legFields: distanceKm is the flown (routed or great-circle) distance used for estimates; greatCircleKm is always present; distanceModel says which; route.airspace and route.diversion describe the modelled constraints.

airportIdentifiers.semantics: Case-insensitive resolution; unknown codes are reported and skipped. Idents containing hyphens use numeric IDs in readable routes; the document syntax accepts 4–8 alphanumeric idents.

timeFormats.offsets: An offset disambiguates airport-local time; it must match the zone at that wall time. Z means local UTC+0, not conversion from UTC.
timeFormats.rules: Runtime Intl IANA rules; DST gaps error, ambiguous times warn and choose earlier unless offset supplied.

estimationModel.notes: Great circle on a sphere; no winds, airline schedules, aircraft type or actual flight tracking. Altitude is illustrative.

validation.valid: No error issues; warnings and info preserve validity. Structural validation precedes semantic resolution. Tolerant readable links keep usable values.

issues.meaning: A date was supplied without a time.
No zone mapped for this airport.
Runtime Intl does not support the mapped zone.
Repeated hour; earlier instant used unless an offset selects one.
Local time falls in a daylight-saving gap.
Explicit offset is invalid at this airport wall time.
Arrival at origin or departure at destination is ignored.
Arrival must follow departure for a nonzero flight.
Entered duration differs substantially from the estimate.
Future times use current runtime time-zone rules.

tripIssues.meaning: A section departs before the previous section arrives.

agentIssues.meaning: Multi-journey documents require compare_journeys for calculations and timelines.
Multi-section trips are planned as trips (calculate_route), not as one journey.
routing.diversion must be a boolean or 60–370 minutes.
Readable route syntax or limits invalid.
assumeDeparture is not an ISO instant.
Undated timeline needs an explicit anchor.
Sample count or instant array exceeds bounds.
Clock must identify local, utc or an airport in this route.
Selected flight must exist in this route.

warnings.meaning: Requested routing data is not available here; those flights follow great circles.
The complete document URL exceeds limits; use the available readable URL.

versioning: Additive compatible changes retain v1. Breaking changes require document version 2 and a v2 link parameter/version contract; existing v1 links remain readable.

dataset.airports: OurAirports, public domain; checked daily, freshness is recorded rather than guaranteed.
dataset.timeZones: timezone-boundary-builder 2026f, derived from OpenStreetMap; ODbL-1.0. Separate derivative database at src/data/generated/timezones.json.

mcp.prerequisites: Node >=22.18; npm ci in the checkout.

webMcp.api: document.modelContext (AbortSignal cleanup), legacy navigator.modelContext registerTool/unregisterTool or provideContext

licences.earth: NASA public-use imagery; attribution in project notices
